_readme: Storage cost estimates for detail-panel display. All figures transcribed from primary documents (see data/research/storage_costs.md). Costs are highly scale- and site-sensitive; these are indicative, not site-specific.

netl_us_formations.source: Morgan et al. (2024), 'Modeling the Cost of CO2 Saline Storage on a Regional and National Level', NETL e-poster, AGU24 (OSTI 2484162)
netl_us_formations.basis: First-year break-even price (all-in: capital, O&M, financing, Class VI permitting, Subpart RR monitoring), 2023 US$/t CO2, FE/NETL CO2_S_COM v4 run over 314 US saline formations. Lowest-cost formation per state.
netl_us_formations.national_curve_note: >200 Gt of prospective US storage resource at <=$8/t nationally; all regions except the Northeast have >=60 Gt at <=$10/t; the Northeast has ~1 Gt at <=$40/t.
netl_us_formations.notes: Formation names are NETL database roots (numbered instances collapsed, e.g. 'Frio2' -> 'Frio'). Kentucky has two entries in the poster (Lockport6 $158.31 NE-region, Knox5 $10.88 Midwest-region); the lower Knox figure is used as KY's lowest-cost formation. States absent have no formation in the 314-formation database.

qgess_us_basins.source: NETL QGESS: Carbon Dioxide Transport and Storage Costs in NETL Studies (2019), DOE/NETL-2019/2044
qgess_us_basins.basis: Combined transport (~100 km pipeline) + storage cost, 2018 US$/t CO2, for representative sites in four basins.

strategy_ccus_eu.source: Chen, L. (2022), 'D4.5 Cost-effectiveness of storage sites and comparison of promising regions', STRATEGY CCUS (EU H2020 project 837754), Table 1
strategy_ccus_eu.basis: Storage-only capex+opex (monitoring bundled in opex; excludes capture and transport), undiscounted EUR/t CO2 stored; project report, not peer-reviewed. Sites had not reached bankability status; costs assume storage-ready resources (report's own flagged inconsistency).

Rhone Valley.prospects: Sainte Marie de la Mer; Donnemarie

Northern Croatia.prospects: Benicanci; Boksic; Osijek; Drava (depleted fields + saline)

class_ranges.source: Schmelz, Hochman & Miller (2020), Interface Focus 10:20190065, cost parameterization drawing on Rubin, Davison & Herzog (2015), IJGGC 40:378
class_ranges.basis: Generic reservoir-class storage cost ranges (low / representative / high, US$/t CO2); not site-specific; excludes capture, transport, and monitoring (Schmelz et al. exclude monitoring explicitly).

caveat: Storage costs are highly sensitive to injection rate, project scale, depth, and reservoir quality (order 2-10x within one basin), and vintages differ across sources. Figures are indicative, storage-only unless noted (QGESS includes ~100 km transport). None include capture.
